TC-23/S24.title: A wrong device clock: dictation and sign-in
TC-23/S24.detail: Local stack 8b4be94a (round-companion-wt-qa), under runs/.local-stack.lock and the AI tripwire ('no model call'); every ai/* action answered at the Convex socket. rb1-tc23-client.spec.ts -g S24 with prepareSession stubbed (expiresAt = host clock + 60 s, what the real call asks OpenAI for; the original passes realPrepare and would mint an OpenAI credential). Clock +70 s and +24 h: 'Live dictation couldn’t start.', nothing lands, both modes (B33; liveSession.ts unchanged). +24 h also opens on the sign-in screen and needs a UI sign-in. Clock +0, +50 s, −24 h and Honolulu: the take lands the same text as the control; the case's oracle still marks those cells failed only because it expects a prepareSession diagnostics row, which a socket stub does not write (runner artifact, not counted).

stated.where: ours: device clock skew (3.8 names time rules, not dictation)
